services.desc: Hot air ballooning across the United States offers an array of breathtaking experiences, each showcasing the country’s diverse landscapes and unique charms. From the deserts of New Mexico to the forests of New Hampshire, these aerial adventures provide a stunning perspective on some of America’s most beautiful regions. Here’s a guide to some of the top hot air ballooning destinations within the USA. The Experience: During the Balloon Fiesta, held every October, hundreds of balloons ascend simultaneously, creating a vibrant tapestry against the clear blue sky.
